observations.finding: BAP1 mutation frequency 29.3% in C0001 vs 1.6% in rest; OR 25.2 (95% CI 3.13-203.5), q=0.0010, 12/41 vs 1/62 mutated.
No CNV feature significant at q<0.05 (min q=0.22 continuous, 0.48 gain/loss); top effects chr1q gain (delta 0.37) and chr9q loss (delta -0.32) are nonsignificant.

evidence_reports.statistical_interpretation: A single strong, coherent WXS signal (BAP1 enrichment) survives multiple-testing correction with a large effect and CI excluding 1. CNV shows no significant findings; top effects are directionally present but nonsignificant.
evidence_reports.medical_interpretation: C0001 is defined by a BAP1-mutant-enriched molecular profile, consistent with a recognized ccRCC biology; CNV does not independently corroborate but does not contradict.
limitations: BAP1 based on 12 mutated cases; wide OR CI upper bound.
CNV nonsignificant, no corroboration.

observations.finding: PBRM1 mutation frequency 76% in C0002 vs 25.6% in rest; OR 9.18 (95% CI 3.22-26.2), q=0.00024, 19/25 vs 20/78 mutated.
7/49 CNV features significant at q<0.05; chr16q (delta -0.48), chr16p (delta -0.48), chr8p (delta 0.47), VHL locus (delta -0.47), SETD2 locus (delta -0.45), all q<=0.019.
chr8p loss depleted in C0002 (0% vs 33.3%, OR 0.039, q=0.015).

evidence_reports.statistical_interpretation: Strong coherent WXS signal (PBRM1 enrichment) plus multiple significant CNV features with consistent direction (16q/16p/VHL/SETD2 lower, 8p higher). Both modalities converge.
evidence_reports.medical_interpretation: C0002 shows a PBRM1-mutant-enriched profile with concordant CNV alterations, consistent with a distinct ccRCC molecular phenotype.
limitations: CNV and WXS are not independent validation but provide cross-modality coherence.

observations.finding: PBRM1 mutation frequency 0% in C0003 vs 46.4% in rest; OR 0.030 (95% CI 0.0017-0.505), q=0.00093, 0/19 vs 39/84 mutated.
VHL mutation frequency 15.8% in C0003 vs 63.1% in rest; OR 0.110 (95% CI 0.030-0.407), q=0.0025, 3/19 vs 53/84 mutated.
chr9q (delta 0.56, q=0.023) and JAK2 locus (delta 0.50, q=0.049) higher in C0003; 2/49 significant.

evidence_reports.statistical_interpretation: Two strong, coherent WXS depletions (PBRM1, VHL) with CIs excluding 1 and q<0.01. CNV shows two significant features (chr9q, JAK2) with consistent direction.
evidence_reports.medical_interpretation: C0003 is characterized by near-absence of PBRM1 and marked VHL mutation depletion, a distinct molecular profile from the PBRM1/VHL-enriched sets.
limitations: Small set (n=19); CNV corroboration limited to two features.

observations.finding: VHL mutation frequency 83.3% in C0004 vs 48.2% in rest; OR 5.37 (95% CI 1.45-19.9), nominal p=0.0084 but q=0.185 (not significant after correction).
No CNV feature significant at q<0.05 (min q=1.0); top effects chr19p (delta 0.32) and chr11q (delta -0.24) nonsignificant.

evidence_reports.statistical_interpretation: Only a nominal VHL enrichment that does not survive multiple-testing correction; CNV entirely nonsignificant. Evidence is weak.
evidence_reports.medical_interpretation: C0004 shows a directionally VHL-enriched profile but without adjusted statistical support; biological distinctiveness is not established by these modalities.
limitations: VHL q=0.185, not significant after correction.
No CNV support.

observations.finding: C0001 enriched for CJ site (24.4% vs 1.6%, OR 19.7, q=0.017) and depleted for BP (24.4% vs 56.5%, q=0.049).
Global significant fields include tissue_source_site (q=0.008), ct_phase (q=0.032), ct_manufacturer (q=0.004), ct_scanner_model (q=0.004), ct_reconstruction_kernel (q=0.014); Cramers V all <0.33.

evidence_reports.statistical_interpretation: C0001 has significant tissue-source-site imbalance, a plausible competing explanation for a set defined partly by site-correlated features. Effect sizes are moderate (Cramers V ~0.26).
evidence_reports.medical_interpretation: Technical/site confounding cannot be excluded for C0001; the CJ-site enrichment is a notable competing explanation.
limitations: Cramers V below warning threshold (0.5) but site imbalance is significant.

observations.finding: C0002 strongly enriched for BP site (76% vs 33.3%, OR 6.33, q=0.0084).
C0002 enriched for GE manufacturer (92% vs 60.3%, q=0.032), LightSpeed16 scanner (60% vs 20.5%, q=0.0084), STANDARD kernel (88% vs 52.6%, q=0.028).

evidence_reports.statistical_interpretation: C0002 shows multiple significant technical associations (site, manufacturer, scanner model, kernel), indicating a plausible competing technical explanation for the set.
evidence_reports.medical_interpretation: Technical confounding is a concern for C0002; the strong BP-site and CT-acquisition enrichment could contribute to set separation.
limitations: Cramers V below warning threshold but multiple fields significant.

actions.reason: C0001 has a coherent identity signal (BAP1 mutation enrichment, OR 25.2, q=0.0010), but cross-modal cohesion is weak (silhouettes near zero) and significant tissue-source-site imbalance (CJ enrichment, q=0.017) leaves a plausible technical competing explanation. No available evidence request remains, so this candidate is retained for downstream validation with these caveats.

C0002 shows the strongest coherent identity evidence (PBRM1 enrichment OR 9.18, q=0.00024, with concordant CNV features) and the best cross-modal support (median support 3, positive wsi/wxs/cnv silhouettes). However, multiple significant technical associations (BP site, GE manufacturer, LightSpeed16 scanner, STANDARD kernel) leave a plausible competing technical explanation, so it is retained for downstream validation with this caveat.

C0003 has coherent identity evidence (PBRM1 and VHL depletion, q<0.01) and no significant technical confounding. Its coherence is largely WXS-driven (wxs silhouette 0.613, other modalities near zero), so cross-modal consistency is limited, but no available evidence request remains and the candidate is retained for downstream validation.

C0004 has only weak identity evidence (VHL enrichment nominal p=0.0084 but q=0.185, no CNV support) and its coherence is essentially WXS-driven with no all-modality-positive patients. No technical confounding is detected, and no available evidence request remains, so it is retained as a discovery-stage candidate with substantial uncertainty.
